tha-ap366:1.1: samattaṃ. [361. Kesarapupphiya.] Vijjādharo tadā āsiṃ Himavantamhi pabbate / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ caṅkamantaṃ mahāyasaṃ. // //
tha-ap366:2.1: Tīṇi kesarapupphāni sīse katvān' ahaṃ tadā / upasaṅkamma sambuddhaṃ *Vessabhum abhi*pūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap366:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap366:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kesarapupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
